themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles discussing AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, interact with systems, and make decisions within a research context.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Content focused on AI tools that assist developers in writing, debugging, and refactoring code, including AI agents dedicated to coding tasks.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Articles about platforms, software, and services that leverage AI to aid researchers in various stages of their work, from data analysis to discovery.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Discussions on how AI affects jobs, employment, skills, and the overall labor market, including concerns about job displacement and AI-driven role changes.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Content related to AI's ability to condense large amounts of text, data, or conversations into concise summaries, aiding in efficient information processing.

themes.name: AI research tools comparison
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, or benchmark different AI tools and platforms available for research purposes.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating software testing processes, including test case generation, execution, and result analysis.

themes.name: AI content generation
themes.description: Articles about AI systems that create various forms of content, such as text, images, code, or marketing materials.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discussions about dedicated platforms designed to facilitate and manage AI-driven research activities.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Articles exploring the application of AI in the design process and user research, from ideation to analysis.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
